is_code_fix.description: True only when the verified root cause is resolved by changing this repository's source.

root_cause.description: One or two sentences naming the confirmed cause.

cause_quote.description: Verbatim cause from the matched playbook's 'What can cause it' list, if a playbook matched.

playbook.description: Path of the matched troubleshooting playbook, if any.

source.description: Raw capture file and field, or a source file and line.

proposed_changes.description: Source edits to apply (empty when is_code_fix is false or confidence is low).

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

non_code_actions.description: Operational fixes to recommend (Orchestrator config, credentials, assets, data, external systems).

summary_md.description: Concise markdown narrative of the investigation for the PR or issue body.
